{{Quote|It is with the deepest regret that I must return to you your thirty-thousand credit bond and your Princess.|Madam Nestor, to Bail Prestor Organa|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
'''Madam Nestor''' was the governess of [[Crevasse City Collegium for Young Ladies]]. In [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]], she sent a letter to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] to inform him of the expulsion and several infractions of his adoptive daughter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].

==Behind the scenes==
Madam Nestor first appeared in a databank entry for Princess Leia in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.
